topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and sets expectations for how previously learned immune components fit together.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition of infection and damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems by which the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage.

topics.label: Acute inflammatory activation and leukocyte recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular mechanisms of acute inflammation that recruit immune cells to tissues and mediate systemic responses.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the body terminates acute inflammation, rebuilds damaged tissue, and manages persistent inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
